info.name: Mabany Real Estate & Engineering API
info.description:
# Mabany Real Estate & Engineering REST API

Welcome to the official Postman Collection for consuming the Mabany REST API.

## Overview
This collection provides full coverage for all public endpoints, localization options (`ar` / `en`), request parameter configurations, request body validation rules, and realistic response examples (Success 200/201, Not Found 404, Validation Error 422, Rate Limiting 429).

## Environment Variables
- `base_url`: Target server URL (e.g. `http://127.0.0.1:8000` or `http://mabany.test`)
- `locale`: Active language (`ar` for Arabic, `en` for English)

## Global Headers
- `Accept`: `application/json`
- `Accept-Language`: `{{locale}}`

## Rate Limits
- `POST /api/contact` is throttled to 6 submissions per minute per IP (`throttle:6,1`).

request.description:
Submits a new inquiry or quotation request. Rate limited to 6 requests per minute (`throttle:6,1`).

### Validation Rules:
- `full_name`: Required | string | max:255
- `email`: Required | email | max:255
- `phone`: Required | string | max:50
- `solution_type`: Required without `page_slug` | nullable | string | max:255
- `message`: Required without `page_slug` | nullable | string
- `page_slug`: Required without `solution_type` | nullable | string | max:255

response.name: 201 Created - Submission Successful
422 Unprocessable Entity - Validation Error
